'''Lucien Dodge''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and other [[Pokémon animation]]. He is currently affiliated with VOX Inc.

==Biography==
Dodge was born in Ithaca, New York, and became a voice actor as an adult. He began to provide voices for {{aniseries|PTS}} when {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|took over the dubbing and distribution of the series]]. His most prominent roles are that of [[Chili]] and {{OBP|Blue|Origins}}.

Dodge is one out of only two voice actors to have worked on {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[Pokémon Origins]], and [[Pokémon Generations]], the other being [[Cristina Vee]].
